mapper.insert: INSERT INTO status_change_log (entity_type, entity_id, old_status, new_status, changed_by, changed_at) VALUES (#{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{changedBy}, #{changedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, old_status, new_status, changed_by, changed_at FROM status_change_log WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} ORDER BY changed_at DESC
